prompt: docs/feature-spec.md describes the order cancellation and refund feature. Write the test plan for it to out/test-plan.md: scope, what is out of scope, test data, and the test cases grouped by area, each with its expected result. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Cases cover each rule of the spec: cancel states, who may cancel and refund, refund amount with and without shipping, the 500.00 threshold, one refund per order, refund only after cancel.
Includes boundary cases for the 500.00 threshold (below, at, above) and states an expected result for every case.
States the out-of-scope items from the spec (store credit, audit log, partial refunds) and lists test data.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("out/test-plan.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("shipped|delivered","gi"),R=[new RegExp("reject|cannot|not allowed|refus|denied|error|fail","i")],W=300;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
